releases.notes:
StreamCraft Live 0.34.1 for NeoForge 1.21.1 with one fix, built for The Block Academy (TBA) modpack only.

**Fixed:** opening StreamCraft's Discover page (the button on the Multiplayer screen) a second time within the directory cache window crashed the game with `IllegalStateException: registerWidget outside a build`. A relayout requested while a screen is still building now waits for the build to finish.

Only `com/streamcraft/client/ui/kit/core/KitScreen.class` (and its `Backdrop` inner class) differ from the released 0.34.1 jars; everything else, natives and signed DLLs included, is byte-identical. The proper fix ships in the next StreamCraft release; until then, use the official 0.34.1 everywhere outside TBA.

mods.name: GriefLogger
mods.description: A mod that logs all player interactions with blocks and entities and stores them in a database.

releases.notes:
GriefLogger 1.2.10 for NeoForge 1.21.1 by DAQEM (Apache License 2.0), repackaged by The Block Academy for the TBA server only. Upstream: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/grieflogger

**What changed:** only the bundled `com.google.protobuf` classes (from MySQL Connector/J) are relocated to `com.daqem.grieflogger.shaded.protobuf`. Without this, NeoForge won't start next to StreamCraft, which ships protobuf-java as its own module. No other code or resources changed. The jar's `LICENSE` and `META-INF/TBA-MODIFICATIONS.txt` record this.

TBA goes back to the upstream jar once StreamCraft relocates its protobuf.
